# Module 6 — expected output (read-along; regenerated by maintainers before each delivery)

| File | What it shows |
|---|---|
| `stream.log` | `deploy_toolkit_agent.py all --yes` transcript: `[tool_use: bash] git clone…`, `· model request: in=… cached=… out=…`, `[custom_tool_use: create_ticket]` → `<- custom_tool_result: created AST-0001 …`, the `web_fetch` pause auto-allowed, `[idle: end_turn]` |
| `bug-report.md` | the deliverable downloaded from `/mnt/session/outputs/` in step 5 |
| `usage.json` | `sessions.retrieve(id).usage` — tokens, `active_seconds`, `list_cost` |
| `console-*.png` | Agent quickstart builder, Sessions list, Tracing view, Environments, Deployments, Webhooks |
| `demo.cast` | asciinema recording of the instructor terminal demo (offline fallback) |

Regenerate (instructor org, `source labs/.env` with a full model ID in `CMA_MODEL`):

```bash
cd labs/m6-managed-agents/python/solution && rm -f .cma-state.json tickets.json
uv run python deploy_toolkit_agent.py all --yes 2>&1 | tee ../../expected-output/stream.log
cp bug-report.md ../../expected-output/ && uv run python -c "import json;from deploy_toolkit_agent import *;print(json.dumps(client().beta.sessions.retrieve(load_state()['session_id']).usage.model_dump(),indent=2,default=str))" > ../../expected-output/usage.json
$WS/labs/cleanup.sh --yes
```

Until regenerated for your delivery this folder holds only this README; the module text describes every expected line.
